value.rationale: Log-concavity of general-position polynomials is a motivated global coefficient property. Its sharp first breakdown within the canonical, highly symmetric triangular graph family is a precise finite cutoff not implied by the previously known maximum or minimum general-position cardinalities. A certified n=30 threshold isolates a nontrivial coefficient-shape boundary; no all-orders follow-up is falsely asserted.
